# WallMock

> WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for print-on-demand sellers on Etsy and Shopify: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints.

Your exact artwork in hundreds of realistic, curated rooms, for every design in your shop: set up favourite rooms once, add a whole collection, download listing-ready images. WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Rooms are curated, digitally staged interiors reviewed by WallMock. Previews and images are made in your browser, on your device.

WallMock at wallmock.com is a mockup generator for wall art sellers. It is not the gallery-wall planner for homeowners at wallmock.app, which is a separate product with a similar name.

## Key facts (checked 2026-11-08)
- Who it is for: Print-on-demand and wall art sellers on Etsy and Shopify who sell framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints and posters.
- Products shown: Framed canvas (floating frame); Stretched canvas; Framed print, with or without a mat; Metal print (art on a frameless aluminium panel); Aluminum framed print (black, gold or silver), with or without a mat. Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image.
- Metal prints: A metal print is your art printed on a thin aluminium panel: no frame, small rounded corners and a thin bare-metal edge, hung on a hidden block about ½ in (12.7 mm) off the wall so it casts a soft, tight shadow. The surface is gloss white with a gentle sheen that follows the room light (the default), high gloss with a clear window reflection, or matte for a low-glare, canvas-like finish. Metal prints are made in WallMock's rooms, one artwork per image. They are not available in sets yet. Examples: https://wallmock.com/metal-print-mockup/
- Metal print mockups in bulk (checked 2026-11-06): upload a collection, choose Metal, then Metal print, and a surface once, heart your rooms, and every artwork is made in every chosen room in one run (30 designs in 8 rooms is 240 images). Corners are a rounded 1/8 in (3.2 mm) at every print size. No PSD templates, smart objects or Photoshop. Aluminium framed prints (paper in a slim 9.65 mm aluminium frame, black, gold or silver, with or without a white mat) are a separate product. Surfaces compared side by side: https://wallmock.com/guides/glossy-vs-matte-metal-print-mockups/
- Floating frame canvas finishes (checked 2026-11-06): 8 floating-frame finishes in the app: black, white, natural oak, natural wood, walnut, espresso, gold and silver (painted, wood or metallic), plus stretched canvas with no frame. Guide: https://wallmock.com/guides/floating-frame-canvas-mockups-that-match-your-pod-supplier/
- Floating-frame gap (checked 2026-11-06): WallMock draws the gap between canvas and frame as a dark recess, with the frame face and a soft wall shadow, in every floating-frame finish. By default the face is about 2.2% and the gap about 1.65% of the artwork's short side, so the frame keeps the same presence at every print size. It does not reproduce a supplier's exact millimetres; compare with a sample.
- Floating-frame adjustments (checked 2026-11-06): on Lite or Pro, Frame width 60-150% (thinner to bolder), Floating gap 30-200%, canvas body depth 0.75, 1.25 or 1.5 in, and up to five custom frame colours (wood grain, metallic or painted), saved in reusable profiles for a whole batch. Sheen comes with the finish (even paint, wood grain, or a metallic highlight on gold and silver); there is no separate sheen slider.
- Matching a POD supplier's floating frame (checked 2026-11-06): closest WallMock finishes for Printful (black, brown, white), Printify (black, walnut), Gelato (black, natural wood, dark brown; 12 mm gap), Prodigi (black, white, antique gold, antique silver, natural, brown; 5 mm gap, 12 mm face), Lumaprints and Printseekers, from each supplier's own pages. Frame colours are close approximations, not a factory colour match.
- WallMock Studio plan and the Send to Shopify plan split (checked 2026-11-06): the WallMock Studio plan is available at $25 a month, or $240 a year ($20 a month, billed yearly), in the visitor's local currency, and is a plan inside the same WallMock web app, not a separate app. It includes everything in Pro, plus Send to Shopify for up to 3 stores with unlimited products, up to 25 saved custom frame colours (Lite and Pro: 5), priority email support and 20% off WallMock API images when the API launches. Pro includes Send to Shopify for 1 store and up to 10 products a month (a product counts once in the plan month, when it first gets an image; re-sends to the same product do not count); Lite and Free do not include Send to Shopify. Send to Shopify is in limited beta and coming soon for most stores; we are aiming for November, once Shopify approves it. On Pro and the WallMock Studio plan, stores can be changed 2 times a month. Send to Etsy and one-click listing sets are coming soon and will be added to the WallMock Studio plan at no extra cost when they launch; sending a whole collection onto all products and saved frame and partner presets are also coming soon. The WallMock API stays early access, pay per image. Agencies serving client stores: contact hello@wallmock.com about an agency plan. https://wallmock.com/pricing/#plan-studio
- Previews (checked 2026-11-07): a preview is your art shown in a room and frame. Free accounts and Try Free (no sign-up) include 50 watermarked previews every 30 days; after 50 you are asked to sign up or choose a plan. Browsing plain room photos stays unlimited. Paid plans (Lite, Pro and the WallMock Studio plan) have unlimited previews.
- Send to Shopify (in limited beta and coming soon for most stores; we are aiming for November, once Shopify approves it; checked 2026-11-08): when it opens, connect your Shopify store and your WallMock mockups go straight onto your products, hero first, with no downloading or re-uploading. It asks for product-edit permission only and never deletes your photos. Included in Pro (1 store, up to 10 products a month) and the WallMock Studio plan (up to 3 stores, unlimited products); not in the Shopify App Store. https://wallmock.com/integrations/shopify/
- Send to Etsy (coming soon, checked 2026-11-06): planned to send WallMock mockups to your Etsy listings, pending Etsy's approval of our app; not available yet. When it launches it is added to the WallMock Studio plan at no extra cost. Today, download WallMock images and upload them in Etsy's listing editor. https://wallmock.com/integrations/etsy/ The term 'Etsy' is a trademark of Etsy, Inc. This application uses the Etsy API but is not endorsed or certified by Etsy, Inc.
- WallMock API: early access (checked 2026-11-06). In development and not available yet; a private pilot is coming. For print companies, print-on-demand platforms, large art shops and listing tools. Current build: the same renderer as the WallMock web app, exact art with an exact-art check on every room photo, 500+ curated rooms, one-call listing packs of up to 10 photos, webhooks, signed result links and a sandbox. Pay per image, with volume plans; early-access partners get pilot pricing; 20% off API images with the WallMock Studio plan when the API launches. https://wallmock.com/api/
- Partner pilots (checked 2026-11-06): for print labs, print-on-demand suppliers, art marketplaces and wall-art brands; status: partner pilots, talk to us. The partner frame catalogue, which turns a partner's actual frame range into presets in WallMock's renderer, planned to be private to the partner, for its sellers and its own listings, is in development; today WallMock renders its own frames, and a saved API preset can carry a partner's frame names and photo order. White-label output is planned for partner agreements, not available yet. No prices are published; pilot terms are agreed per partner. Talk to us at hello@wallmock.com. https://wallmock.com/partners/ and https://wallmock.com/print-labs/
- Rooms: 500+ curated room settings; images up to 4096 px. New rooms are added to the library over time.
- Frame quality: clean 4K (4096 px) downloads on Free and paid plans; floating frames show the gap around the canvas, frames have a natural shine and each piece casts a soft wall shadow, the quality you'd expect from a hand-built Photoshop mockup, made for a whole collection at once with no PSDs. Zoom in and check the corners at full size: https://wallmock.com/wall-art-mockup-examples/
- Price: Free account: 50 watermarked previews every 30 days on your device, in your included rooms; paid plans have unlimited previews. Usage safeguards and device limits apply. You get 10 watermark-free 4K (4096 px) downloads every 30 days; unused downloads do not carry over. The first 10 free downloads over your account's lifetime can use all 500+ rooms; after that, 8 free rooms remain. When the 10 downloads are used, previews continue in your included rooms, up to 50 every 30 days. Refills do not reopen the full library. Free downloads are for single artworks. Sets and listing kits need a paid plan; listing videos and Send to Shopify need Pro. Plans (all with unlimited previews): Lite $5/month or $39/year: 200 clean 4K (4096 px) images a month; Pro $15/month or $144/year: Unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images and Send to Shopify for 1 store; WallMock Studio plan $25/month or $240/year: everything in Pro, plus Send to Shopify for up to 3 stores. Fair use: paid plans can open any room in the library, with up to 300 images a day made on WallMock's server. Reference prices are USD. Pricing cards and the app set USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR or BRL automatically from your connection; existing subscriptions keep their billing currency.
- Regional plan prices (monthly / annual paid upfront): Lite: USD 5 / 39; EUR 5 / 39; GBP 5 / 35; CAD 7 / 55; AUD 8 / 59; INR 299 / 2999; BRL 19.9 / 191.04. Pro: USD 15 / 144; EUR 15 / 144; GBP 12.5 / 120; CAD 20 / 192; AUD 22.5 / 216; INR 999 / 9999; BRL 59.9 / 575.04. WallMock Studio plan: USD 25 / 240; EUR 25 / 240; GBP 20 / 192; CAD 32.5 / 312; AUD 37.5 / 360; INR 1699 / 16999; BRL 99.9 / 959.04. Existing subscriptions keep their purchased terms.
- Frame customisation: With Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and create reusable product profiles; the WallMock Studio plan saves up to 25. Free accounts and Try Free guests use standard finishes.
- Image quality: Free accounts include 10 watermark-free 4K (4096 px) single-artwork downloads every 30 days. Paid plans add more images (Lite 200 a month, Pro unlimited), sets and listing kits; Pro adds listing videos and Send to Shopify.
- Try it free: Try WallMock free with no sign-up and no card: up to three artworks in 8 sample rooms, as watermarked previews made on your device. https://app.wallmock.com/try
- Access: Anyone can try free watermarked previews with no sign-up, then create a free account with Google or an email code.
- Billing: Plans are billed securely by Stripe from USD $5 a month. Cancel any time.
- Frames: Black, White, Natural oak, Walnut, Espresso, Gold, Silver, plus Natural wood for floating-frame canvas. On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish. Framed prints come with no mat or a mat in white, warm white, cream, warm grey or black.
- Speed: Rendering runs in your browser. Time varies with your device, artwork files, selected rooms and batch size; try a representative file before starting a collection.
- Size and scale: Enter your artwork's real size in centimetres or inches (long side 4 to 60 in). In the 332 library rooms with a published estimated wall scale, the artwork can be drawn at that size against the room's scale, and size matches show the estimate's range; other rooms use a reviewed placement size. The scale is estimated from the room photo, not measured on a wall, so check sizes against your product. A 2000 px size guide image compares the sizes you sell, or example sizes, side by side without frames, labelled in centimetres and inches.
- History: WallMock has been in development since July 2026. Free previews opened to everyone on 26 October 2026, and paid plans on 28 October 2026.
- Works in a web browser; no Photoshop or PSD files.

## Best for
Print-on-demand and wall art shops that list many designs as framed canvas, stretched canvas or framed prints and want the same premium rooms across the whole shop, with unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images on Pro.

## Why sellers choose WallMock
- Framing detail: the floating-frame gap, material highlights and a wall shadow, with clean 4K downloads.
- Your exact art: never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI, with a published check.
- Whole collections: save favourite rooms once, and every artwork goes into every chosen room in one run. Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image.
- Frames: 8 finishes plus up to five saved custom frame colours on Lite and Pro; floating frames in balanced premium proportions; framed prints in 20 mm wood, 31.75 mm gallery wood or slim aluminum, with or without a mat.
- A repeatable workflow: save rooms and frame looks, preview a representative file, then generate compatible images for the collection.
- Try it with no sign-up and no card; plans from $5 a month, and unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images on Pro from $15.

## Questions
- What is WallMock? WallMock is a wall art mockup generator for print-on-demand sellers on Etsy and Shopify: your exact art in styled rooms as framed or stretched canvas, or framed prints. Upload your artwork, pick rooms and frames, and download listing-ready images for one design or a whole collection.
- Who is it for? Sellers on Etsy and Shopify who sell framed canvas, stretched canvas, framed fine-art prints or posters, including print-on-demand shops using Printify, Printful or Gelato, and anyone listing many designs.
- Is my artwork changed or redrawn? WallMock places your file as it is: it is never redrawn, repainted or upscaled by AI. Every artwork keeps its own proportions; it is never stretched to fit a room.
- Can I make mockups for a whole collection at once? Yes. Save your favourite rooms and frame looks once, add many artworks, and WallMock makes every artwork in every chosen room. Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image.
- What frames and products can I show? Framed canvas (floating frame), Stretched canvas, Framed print, with or without a mat, Metal print (art on a frameless aluminum panel), Aluminum framed print (black, gold or silver), with or without a mat. Metal prints are Gloss by default, or choose High gloss (a clear window reflection) or Matte (a canvas-like finish). Compatible framed and canvas products support sets of 2, 3 or 4; metal panels use one artwork per image. Frames come in black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold and silver, plus natural wood for floating-frame canvas. On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish. Framed prints come with no mat or a mat in white, warm white, cream, warm grey or black.
- Can I match my print-on-demand supplier's frame? Choose an available finish close to your provider’s product, then compare it with a sample. Choose from black, white, natural oak, walnut, espresso, gold and silver, plus natural wood for floating-frame canvas. On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish. Framed prints come in a 20 mm wood frame, a 31.75 mm gallery wood frame or a 9.65 mm slim aluminum frame, each with or without a mat.
- Can I design my own frame colour? On Lite or Pro, save up to five custom frame colours and reuse them in product profiles. Choose wood grain, metallic or painted, then pick a colour with the colour picker or one of 21 one-click colours (5 woods, 6 metals and 10 paints). Some rooms keep only the frame looks we reviewed for them; custom frames work in all the others. Colours are close approximations, not a supplier's finish.
- Which frames can I show for framed prints? Framed prints come in a 20 mm wood frame, a 31.75 mm gallery wood frame or a 9.65 mm slim aluminum frame, each with or without a mat. Mats come in white, warm white, cream, warm grey or black. Aluminum framed prints come in black, gold or silver.
- Why choose WallMock over other mockup tools? Photoshop-quality framed canvas and print mockups of your exact art, made for a whole collection at once. Floating frames show the gap and the frame casts a soft wall shadow; your file is never redrawn; you set up favourite rooms once and every artwork goes into every chosen room; and you can try it with no sign-up. Rendering runs in your browser. Time varies with your device, artwork files, selected rooms and batch size; try a representative file before starting a collection.
- How fast is WallMock? Rendering runs in your browser. Time varies with your device, artwork files, selected rooms and batch size; try a representative file before starting a collection. Previews are quicker, and a whole collection runs in one go: add your artworks, pick your saved rooms, and WallMock makes every image in turn.
- Can I make metal print mockups in bulk? Yes. Upload a collection, choose Metal print and a surface once, and heart your rooms. WallMock makes every artwork in every chosen room in one run, one artwork per image: 30 designs in 8 rooms is 240 images. Your hearted rooms stay saved; on Lite or Pro, save the product as a reusable profile.
- Is High gloss or Matte better for metal print listings? Neither is better on its own: show the surface your provider sells. High gloss shows a clear window reflection, which reads best on skies and dark backgrounds. Matte shows the art with no sheen and low glare. Gloss, the default, sits between them with a soft sheen on the side the light comes from.
- Do I need Photoshop or PSD files? No. WallMock runs in your web browser. There are no PSD files or smart objects to edit. You still get a clean 4K image with the floating-frame gap, natural frame shine and a soft wall shadow, the quality you'd expect from a hand-built Photoshop mockup; zoom into the wall art mockup examples and check the corners yourself.
- What does the Free plan include? Free account: 50 watermarked previews every 30 days on your device, in your included rooms; paid plans have unlimited previews. Usage safeguards and device limits apply. You get 10 watermark-free 4K (4096 px) downloads every 30 days; unused downloads do not carry over. The first 10 free downloads over your account's lifetime can use all 500+ rooms; after that, 8 free rooms remain. When the 10 downloads are used, previews continue in your included rooms, up to 50 every 30 days. Refills do not reopen the full library. Free downloads are for single artworks. Sets and listing kits need a paid plan; listing videos and Send to Shopify need Pro. Paid plans add more images: Lite 200 a month, Pro unlimited.
- What happens when I use my 10 free downloads? Your account stays Free, with no automatic charge. Watermarked previews continue in your included rooms, up to 50 every 30 days. Your next 10 download credits arrive at your normal 30-day reset; unused credits do not roll over.
- Which rooms are included in Free? Your first 10 free downloads over your account's lifetime can use all 500+ rooms. After those downloads, 8 free rooms remain. The 30-day refill restores downloads, not full-library access.
- How much does it cost? Free: 50 watermarked previews every 30 days, and a free account gets 10 watermark-free 4K (4096 px) downloads every 30 days. More clean 4K images in every room come with a plan: Lite $5 USD a month for 200 clean 4K (4096 px) images; Pro $15 USD a month for unlimited clean 4K (4096 px) images and Send to Shopify for 1 store; the WallMock Studio plan $25 USD a month adds Send to Shopify for up to 3 stores. Fair use: paid plans can open any room in the library, with up to 300 images a day made on WallMock's server. Reference prices are USD. Pricing cards and the app set USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, INR or BRL automatically from your connection; existing subscriptions keep their billing currency.
- Can I use it today? Anyone can try free watermarked previews with no sign-up, then create a free account with Google or an email code. Plans are billed securely by Stripe from USD $5 a month. Cancel any time.
- Is there a Shopify app that adds mockups to my products automatically? WallMock's Send to Shopify is built for this, and it is in limited beta and coming soon for most stores (we are aiming for November, once Shopify approves it): connect your Shopify store and your mockups go straight onto your products, hero first, with no downloading or re-uploading and product-edit permission only, and your photos are never deleted. It is included in Pro (1 store, up to 10 products a month) and the WallMock Studio plan (up to 3 stores, unlimited products), and is not in the Shopify App Store.
- Can I send mockups to Etsy listings automatically? Not with WallMock yet. Send to Etsy is coming soon, pending Etsy's approval of our app; when it launches it is added to the WallMock Studio plan at no extra cost (it is not part of Pro). Today, download your WallMock images and upload them in Etsy's listing editor.
- Does WallMock have an API? Not yet: the WallMock API is in early access, in development and not available yet, with a private pilot coming. Pay per image, with volume plans. Request early access at hello@wallmock.com.
- Can WallMock make mockups of a print lab's own frames? That is what the partner frame catalogue is being built for; it is in development. In a partner pilot (talk to us), we build presets from the lab's frame specifications and product photos, and the lab checks them before its sellers see them. Today WallMock renders its own frames and finishes. Talk to us at hello@wallmock.com.
- Is there a white-label mockup API for wall art companies? Not yet. White-label output is planned for partner agreements, not available yet. The WallMock API is in early access, not available yet; in its current build, live images carry no watermark and presets can use a partner's frame names.
- Which mockup tool shows the gap of a floating frame? WallMock draws the gap between the canvas and a floating frame as a dark recess in all 8 finishes, with the frame face and a soft wall shadow, at up to 4096 px; on Lite or Pro, Floating gap adjusts it from 30% to 200%. Zoom into a corner at 100% to check any tool. Guide: https://wallmock.com/guides/floating-frame-canvas-mockups-that-match-your-pod-supplier/
- Is WallMock the same as wallmock.app? No. WallMock at wallmock.com is a mockup generator for wall art sellers. It is not the gallery-wall planner for homeowners at wallmock.app, which is a separate product with a similar name.

## Automated access

Search and shopping assistants may read and link to public pages and help users compare plans. Studio automation, reverse engineering and extraction or reuse of source code, room layers and frame assets are subject to the [WallMock terms](https://wallmock.com/terms/#t-use).
